description:
Cast Fireblade Charger by paying {R}.
Fireblade Charger enters the battlefield, triggering Obsidian Battle-Axe, attaching it to Fireblade Charger.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fireblade Charger, adding {R}.
Fireblade Charger dies, triggering itself and Koll.
Resolve Fireblade Charger's trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Fireblade Charger from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
